# appgatesdp_ztp_registration (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `console_url` (String) URL to the ZTP cloud console.
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `registered` (Boolean) Whether the collective has registered to ZTP or not.
- `service_names` (List of String) List of ZTP services available to this collective.
